label: baseline
notes: Phase 3 router as reported in the mid-year report. Topic labels, 4 folds, superseded by baseline_topic.

label: baseline_no_rules
notes: Rule-layer ablation on the topic labels at 4 folds. Superseded protocol.

label: taxonomy_v1
notes: Reconstruction of the July 2026 pre-split taxonomy. Different label space, so not a paired comparison.

label: baseline_topic
notes: Flat 7-way router on the benchmark category labels, the ground truth used up to August 2026. Secondary track.

label: baseline_audited
notes: Flat 7-way router on the corrected labels. The reference point for every later change on the primary track.

label: cascade_topic
notes: Two-stage cascade: rules, then a binary safety gate without class re-weighting, then a type classifier trained only on non-safety turns. Threshold 0.5.

notes: Two-stage cascade: rules, then a binary safety gate without class re-weighting, then a type classifier trained only on non-safety turns. Threshold 0.5.
